_comment: SHA-256 of each committed model artifact. joblib files are pickles: loading a tampered file executes arbitrary code. ml_demo refuses to load an artifact whose hash is not listed here. After RETRAINING, regenerate with `python ml/validation/validate_models.py manifest`. Hashes alone do not authenticate the manifest -- protect it with code review.
_trained_with_sklearn_evidence: sklearn 1.9.1 emits InconsistentVersionWarning on unpickling: 'from version 1.9.0'. Retraining under the pinned version is recommended (needs the UCI data).
